professionHooks.note: Formula: Enchant Bracer - Minor Intellect drops from Vile Fin Tidehunter (Silverpine Forest, level 13-14). Kill them while questing there; the pattern teaches Enchant Bracer - Minor Intellect (learn at 70), which the Forever leveling plan uses for 105–110. Reagents: 1x Lesser Magic Essence. Drop chance is not published; treat it as a bonus, not a farm.
